purpose: Operational sufficiency, not retrieval relevance or agent benefit. No model calls or held-out queries.
method: Fresh child process per observation; parent wall time includes process/module startup, operation and response serialization. Per-child peak RSS excludes Git child memory. Fresh database for cold indexing; warm means persisted cache, not a persistent JS process. OS filesystem cache is uncontrolled. Fixed exact-symbol query; one-file comment mutation. Ten samples per warm operation/scale, nearest-rank p50/p95; p95 equals sample maximum, not a stable tail estimate. One near-byte-limit observation per operation; no percentile claim. Immutable Git preparation timed separately, also reported with cold index/check where relevant.
stop_rule: Sequential observations. Record deadline/failure and stop that case's dependent operations; do not lower the input size or silently drop failed samples. No algorithm tuning grid. Fix correctness issues with a separate recorded re-run; retain originals.
heldout_gate: Assessment authoring may inspect pinned source/test changes, but no ctxgate holdout retrieval, model attempts or tuning. Behaviorally unverified tasks remain ineligible. Final evaluation requires all readiness gates and a new explicit run decision.
